title: Verify the Processing Fee Taxable defaults to Yes and shows the tax-jurisdiction note
custom_preconds: 1. On the admin create dialog with Type = Processing Fee.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the Taxable control's default value.
2. Read any note shown below the Taxable setting.
custom_expected:
1. Taxable defaults to 'Yes'.
2. Directly below Taxable this note shows: 'Tax treatment varies by jurisdiction — confirm your local requirements before saving.'
3. The note is plain advice to the shop, not a system instruction or a legal statement.
4. The note is shown only to users with See Financial Data — a user without See Financial Data does not see the note.
